events.detail: A hot rocky world has formed. Water remains largely in the atmosphere and interior.
events.title: PLANET FORMED

events.detail: Cooling has allowed a persistent liquid-water ocean to gather in low terrain.
events.title: STABLE OCEANS DETECTED

events.detail: Primitive self-replicating life has appeared in the ocean, following sustained liquid water and favorable chemical conditions.
events.title: LIFE EMERGED

events.detail: Stable cellular populations have developed. Small biological carbon cycles now influence the oceans and atmosphere.
events.title: MICROBIAL LIFE ESTABLISHED

events.detail: An intense volcanic episode released carbon dioxide and warmed the atmosphere.
events.title: MAJOR VOLCANIC ERUPTION

events.detail: A new metabolic pathway captures sunlight. Carbon uptake and oxygen release will gradually alter the atmosphere.
events.title: PHOTOSYNTHESIS EVOLVED

events.detail: Biological oxygen production has overcome atmospheric sinks. Oxygen now accounts for more than one percent of the atmosphere.
events.title: ATMOSPHERIC OXYGEN RISING
